newsitem.title: FRANCE: French burglar turns lawman in paedophile case.
newsitem.headline: French burglar turns lawman in paedophile case.

text.p: A suspected paedophile went on trial in a French court on Monday, betrayed by a burglar turned law enforcer.
Shocked by video recordings of child sex he found while ransacking the home of Michel Chretien three years ago, the anonymous burglar mailed them to the local police in the eastern town of Nancy.
Justice sources said Chretien, 48, had confessed and faced 10 years in prison if convicted. The burglar is on the run.
